method.pdf_contact_sheet_review: All ten frozen PDF representatives were reviewed through bounded contact sheets; page counts, page dimensions, object structure, and extracted text snippets were used for sparse page choice.
method.dwg_normalization: No new conversion. Six existing Local-A/Local-B normalized DXFs were reused for modelspace/layout counts and fidelity checks.
method.deep_inspection_accounting: Ten frozen PDF documents received bounded page/contact-sheet inspection; six frozen DWG documents received modelspace/paperspace entity-layout inspection using existing normalized evidence. No non-representative source was opened.

opportunity_counts.counting_rule: Counts include units tagged STRONG or PRESENT; they describe source/page opportunity only and are not case labels.

selection_notes: Every frozen family is represented; the one unselected document is the F07 alternate whose bounded pages did not expose a qualified electrical drawing sheet.
DWG paperspace layouts were not selected because all six representative DWGs had empty layouts or only non-printable residual entities; engineering content is primarily in modelspace.
F01 structural, F02 plumbing, and F03 electrical modelspace views are retained with FIDELITY_BLOCKED status and must be excluded from later candidate mining.

F06 selects a plan page and a specification/title page from one project because the roles are materially different; F07 selects two non-identical scanned plan pages from one family and does not count the alternate document as a second source family.
No DWG/PDF cross-format pair was asserted because Local-B recorded zero confirmed or likely pairs.
